latest_release.body: > [!TIP] > Consider enabling analytics (it's like steam survey) in admin settings, I will release this dashboard once I have a consistent 100+ reports each week ## What's Changed **Security**: - [High] apply stored permission caps for customized API tokens with no global flags enabled; minimal tokens still inherit the owner's permissions (GHSA-gfgm-886h-6r47) reporter @thakrarsagar - [Low] SSE source-update and user-targeted delivery hold the client registry lock through nonblocking sends, preventing concurrent map mutation and send-on-closed-channel panics when Realtime clients connect, disconnect, or shut down (GHSA-p9wm-f5jj-75pj) reporter @tao0845 - [Moderate] Moving or renaming a folder updates only shares whose paths are under the moved prefix, preserving per-file share roots instead of retargeting unrelated substring matches (GHSA-26fh-r34c-qxh6) reporters @jayhemnani9910 @dylanzonix - [High] File Size Analyzer hover tooltips render file paths as plain text instead of HTML, closing stored XSS via crafted file names (GHSA-rmjp-pfrq-cc3v) reporter @U3RhcnQ - [Moderate] Passkey registration and deletion now require the account password when a passkey is already configured, and passkeys cannot be altered through generic user profile PATCH (GHSA-r744-4vm3-2px3) reporter @tonghuaroot - [Moderate] Authenticated GET /api/resources/view no longer accepts view tokens minted for a public share when the caller lacks view permission on the requested source (GHSA-wxj5-g3qp-g732) reporter @BlueN0r - [Low] Duplicate finder results are cached per requesting user so filtered file names from one account are not served to another (GHSA-4fhx-8pf6-5gmr) reporter @Nazarami - [Moderate] WebDAV PUT now requires Create permission when the target path does not yet exist, so Modify-only users cannot create new files (GHSA-8655-2ph3-q7q7) reporter @levanduy181 - [Low] Failed-login lockout and auth rate limits now use the rightmost `X-Forwarded-For` hop when proxy headers are trusted, so a client cannot spoof the client IP with a leftmost forwarded value (GHSA-wjp8-g49g-xrhx) reporter @LECOQQ **Bug Fixes**: - Preview generation for WebP images (encode as JPEG thumbnail) ([#3259](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3259), [#3254](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/issues/3254)) - Public share pages show configured banner when API returns `bannerUrl` ([#3250](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3250), [#3246](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/issues/3246)) - Tar extraction creates hard-linked files instead of skipping `TypeLink` entries ([#3234](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3234)) - Embedded JPEG previews for additional RAW/camera formats (ARW, RW2, RAW, RWL) ([#3243](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3243)) - fix(preview): generate WebP image previews by encoding thumbnails as JPEG ([#3259](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3259)) ([#3254](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/issues/3254)) - fix(frontend): show configured share banner on public share pages when API returns `bannerUrl` ([#3250](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3250)) ([#3246](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/issues/3246)) - fix(archive): extract tar hard-linked files instead of skipping `TypeLink` entries ([#3234](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3234)) - fix(preview): embedded JPEG previews for additional RAW/camera formats (RTF, RW2, RAW, RWL) ([#3243](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3243)) - fix(frontend): keep source named `files` in `extractSourceFromPath` ([#3143](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/issues/3143), [#3099](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/pull/3099)) - FileBrowser Quantum

The best free self-hosted web-based file manager.

## Pinned :pushpin: [Read The Official Docs](https://filebrowserquantum.com/) (currently english-only) :pushpin: [v2.0.0 is now stable!](https://filebrowserquantum.com/en/docs/getting-started/v2/about/) --> See [migration support discussion](https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/discussions/3105) ## About FileBrowser Quantum provides an easy way to access and manage your files from the web. It has a modern responsive interface that has many advanced features to manage users, access, sharing, and file preview and editing. This version is called "Quantum" because it packs tons of advanced features into a tiny and easy-to-run file. Unlike the majority of alternative options, FileBrowser Quantum is simple to install and easy to configure. The goal for this repo is to become the best open-source self-hosted file browsing application that exists -- **all for free**. This repo will always be free and open-source. Ready to try it out? See [Getting Started Docs](https://filebrowserquantum.com/en/docs/getting-started/). ## How its different FileBrowser Quantum is a massive fork of the file browser open-source project with the following changes: 1. ✅ Better source configuration - multiple sources, include/exclude rules, and [more](https://filebrowserquantum.com/en/docs/configuration/sources/) 2. ✅ Login support for OIDC, LDAP, JWT, password + 2FA, and proxy. 3. ✅ Beautiful, Responsive, and Customizable user interface. 4. ✅ Streamlined configuration via `config.yaml` config file. 5. ✅ Efficient search - Real-time search results as you type. - Real-time monitoring and updates in the UI. - Search supports file and folder sizes, along with various filters. 6. ✅ Better listing browsing - Thumbnails support includes **office**, **video**, and **album artwork**, and **3D models**. - Faster and more responsive views with animations. - **Folder sizes** are displayed and support thumbnails - Navigating remembers the last scroll position. - WebDAV support - Granular permissions 7. ✅ Highly configurable and [customizable sharing options](https://filebrowserquantum.com/en/docs/shares/options/) - share expiration time - users who can access share (including anonymous) - styling and themes - file viewing, editing, and uploading permissions 8. ✅ Access control that can be scoped to user or group and source path. 9. ✅ Developer API support - Ability to create long-lived API Tokens. - A helpful Swagger page is available at `/swagger` endpoint for API enabled users. Notable features that this fork *does not* have (removed): - ❌ shell commands are completely removed and will not be returned. FileBrowser Quantum differs significantly from the original version. Many of these changes required a significant overhaul. Creating a fork was a necessary process to make the program better. There have been many growing pains, but a stable release is planned and coming soon. ## The UI The UI has a simple three-component navigation system: 1. (Left) Multi-action button with slide-out panel. 2. (Middle) The powerful search bar / title 3. (Right) The view change toggle / overflow menu All other functions are moved either into the action menu or pop-up menus. If the action does not depend on context, it will exist in the slide-out action panel. If the action is available based on context, it will show up as a pop-up menu. ## Official Docs See the [Official Docs](https://filebrowserquantum.com/). Contributions are welcome and encouraged! See [FilebrowserDocs Github](https://github.com/quantumx-apps/filebrowserDocs). ## Comparison Chart Application Name | Quantum | Filebrowser | Filestash | Nextcloud | Google_Drive | FileRun --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | Filesystem support | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | Linux | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | Windows | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | Mac | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | Self hostable | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | Has Stable Release? | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | S3 support | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | webdav support | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | FTP support | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | Dedicated docs site? | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Multiple sources at once | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | Docker image size | 180 MB (with ffmpeg) | 31 MB | 240 MB (main image) | 250 MB | ❌ | > 2 GB | Min.
